tool_schemas.name: check_domain
tool_schemas.description: Checks availability for the requested fully-qualified domain name (FQDN) and, when available for the TLD, returns pricing estimates for the requested term and currency, optionally including premium-domain pricing. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the account_id or fqdn is malformed, the currency is not supported, or term_years is outside 1–10. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist.

account_id.description: Namecheap account id to use for availability/pricing checks.

term_years.description: Registration term length in years used to estimate/register pricing.

include_premium.description: Whether to include premium-domain availability/pricing when supported.

tool_schemas.name: get_dns_hosts
tool_schemas.description: Lists DNS host records for the specified domain, returning a paged result set using limit and cursor and supporting filtering by status, record type, and host plus the requested sort order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if domain_id is malformed, any filter value is not one of the allowed enums, or limit is outside 1–200. Raises NOT_FOUND if the domain_id does not exist.

domain_id.description: Domain id to retrieve DNS host records for.

status.description: Filter DNS host records by status.

record_type.description: Filter DNS host records by record type.

host.description: Filter DNS host records by host/name (e.g., "@", "www").

limit.description: Maximum number of DNS host records to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of DNS host records.

sort.description: Sort order for returned DNS host records.

tool_schemas.name: get_domain_contacts
tool_schemas.description: Lists contact sets (registrant/admin/tech/billing) for the specified domain, returning a paged result set using limit and cursor and supporting filtering by contact status and the requested sort order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if domain_id is malformed, status/sort is not one of the allowed values, or limit is outside 1–50. Raises NOT_FOUND if the domain_id does not exist.

domain_id.description: Domain id to retrieve contact information for.

limit.description: Maximum number of contact sets to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of contact sets.

sort.description: Sort order for returned contact sets.

tool_schemas.name: get_domain_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed information for a single domain in your account by domain_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if domain_id is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the domain_id does not exist.

domain_id.description: Domain id to fetch detailed information for.

tool_schemas.name: get_domain_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists domains for the specified account, returning a paged result set using limit and cursor and supporting filtering by status, TLD, exact fqdn, substring search, auto-renew, WhoisGuard state, and expiry date range with the requested sort order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is malformed, any enum filter/sort is invalid, limit is outside 1–200, or expires_before/expires_after are not valid date-time values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist.

account_id.description: Namecheap account id whose domains should be listed.

fqdn.description: Filter by exact fully-qualified domain name.

expires_before.description: Return only domains with expires_at before this timestamp.

expires_after.description: Return only domains with expires_at after this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of domains to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of domains.

tool_schemas.name: get_tld_pricing
tool_schemas.description: Lists TLD pricing rows for the specified account, returning a paged result set using limit and cursor and supporting filtering by TLD, currency, operation type, duration, and effective timestamp, with an option to include rows that have expired and the requested sort order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is malformed, any enum filter/sort is invalid, duration_years is outside 1–10, limit is outside 1–200, or effective_at is not a valid date-time value. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist.

account_id.description: Namecheap account id whose pricing feed should be used.

duration_years.description: Filter pricing by duration in years.

effective_at.description: Return pricing effective at or before this timestamp.

include_expired.description: Whether to include pricing rows whose expires_at has passed.

limit.description: Maximum number of pricing rows to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of pricing rows.

sort.description: Sort order for returned pricing rows.

tool_schemas.name: register_domain
tool_schemas.description: Creates a domain registration request for the specified FQDN under the given account using the provided contact_set, term_years (1–10), and optional WhoisGuard add-on, and returns the resulting registration record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id or fqdn is malformed, term_years is outside 1–10, required contact_set sections are missing, or contact_set is not an object containing registrant/admin/tech/billing. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist, and CONFLICT if the domain is not available to register.

account_id.description: Namecheap account id to place the registration under.

term_years.description: Number of years to register the domain for.

add_whois_guard.description: Whether to add WhoisGuard privacy to the registration.

contact_set.description: Contact data to use for registration (registrant/admin/tech/billing).

registrant.description: Registrant contact fields for the domain registration.

admin.description: Administrative contact fields for the domain registration.

tech.description: Technical contact fields for the domain registration.

billing.description: Billing contact fields for the domain registration.

tool_schemas.name: create_domain_registration_order
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new domain registration order in status 'draft' for the authenticated account and FQDN, capturing desired term, currency context, optional WhoisGuard, and an optional existing contact_set_id. If a non-terminal order already exists for the same account and fqdn, the service may return that order instead of creating a duplicate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fqdn is invalid, term_years is outside 1–10, or required fields are missing.

currency.description: Currency context for pricing snapshot and subsequent registration.

add_whois_guard.description: Whether to add WhoisGuard (when supported for the TLD).

contact_set_id.description: Existing contact set id to use for registration; must belong to the same domain once created/linked.

tool_schemas.name: get_domain_registration_order
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single domain registration order by order_id for the authenticated account, including its current status, availability result (if checked), and any stored Namecheap order/transaction identifiers. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if order_id is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the order does not exist or is not owned by the authenticated account.

order_id.description: Domain registration order id to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: update_domain_registration_order
tool_schemas.description: Updates a draft/failed domain registration order fields (term_years, add_whois_guard, contact_set_id) or transitions its status where allowed by the lifecycle. Rejects invalid status transitions and refuses updates for terminal orders. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if order_id is malformed, term_years is outside 1–10, or the requested transition is not allowed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the order does not exist or is not owned by the authenticated account.

order_id.description: Domain registration order id to update.

term_years.description: New registration term length in years (1–10).

add_whois_guard.description: Whether to add WhoisGuard (when supported for the TLD).

contact_set_id.description: Contact set id to associate with this order.

status.description: Requested new order status. Transition must be allowed by the order lifecycle.

tool_schemas.name: set_dns_hosts
tool_schemas.description: Replaces the active DNS host records for a domain with the provided set (authoritative sync). Records not present in the requested set are soft-deleted by transitioning them to status 'deleted'; new/changed records are upserted as 'active' while enforcing uniqueness across active records. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if domain_id is malformed, any record_type is invalid, ttl is outside 60–86400 when provided, mx_pref is outside 0–65535 when provided, or the payload contains duplicates. Raises NOT_FOUND if the domain_id does not exist.

domain_id.description: Domain id whose DNS host records will be replaced.

hosts.description: Complete desired set of active DNS host records for the domain.

value.description: Record value/content (e.g., IP address, target hostname, text).

mx_pref.description: MX preference/priority (0–65535), required for MX records.

is_frozen.description: When true, record is treated as locked from modification by background sync.

metadata.name: Namecheap Domains -Search/Register
metadata.description: This backend stores Namecheap-account domain inventory, contact sets, DNS host records, and TLD pricing needed to support domain search and registration workflows.
